python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestRepository
python_interfaces.rule: reader is an LLD-01 Snapshot or current UnitOfWork as appropriate; authoritative identity checks inside a command use the current UoW, no business ID is PK, and repositories never commit internally

python_interfaces.name: RfcRepository
python_interfaces.rule: authoritative exact-number/revision/archive checks use the current UoW and role/source lifecycle are never stored as competing flags on the identity row

python_interfaces.name: RfcHierarchyRepository
python_interfaces.rule: all hierarchy writes run through RfcHierarchyService; cascade capture uses current-UoW reads

python_interfaces.name: SrRfcRelationshipRepository
python_interfaces.rule: direct links only; inherited subordinate context is query-derived

python_interfaces.name: DeviceReferenceRepository
python_interfaces.rule: contains no Network Element persistence authority

python_interfaces.name: TicketDeviceRelationshipRepository
python_interfaces.rule: closed target_type dispatch to owner-specific static SQL; no dynamic table names from client input

python_interfaces.name: WorkingNoteRepository
python_interfaces.rule: closed owner dispatch; note creation receives creating Local User Profile identity only from trusted authenticated command context; creator/creation time/owner are immutable and import code receives no note writer

python_interfaces.name: RfcLifecycleRepository
python_interfaces.rule: projection is current/rebuildable; cascade/archive membership/history is immutable except governed proposal state transitions

python_interfaces.name: RfcHistoryRiskProvider
python_interfaces.rule: bounded indexed checks only; indeterminate fails closed

python_interfaces.name: RfcSourceEvidenceProvider
python_interfaces.rule: LLD-04 owns immutable published source observation/provenance and versioned source vocabulary/precedence; LLD-03 owns accepted current RFC projection and never parses raw workbook content

python_interfaces.name: RfcImportMutationService
python_interfaces.rule: LLD-04 outer proposal-acceptance command supplies already-open UnitOfWork and one command_context/command_id. These methods run all LLD-03 authoritative checks and add required owner audit/result rows but never commit/rollback or create a second command_receipt. When invoked as a standalone LLD-03 command wrapper rather than from LLD-04, that wrapper creates the same single receipt before receipt-FK children. Terminal source projection retains terminal-epoch + pending-cascade atomicity and never executes the cascade.

python_interfaces.name: RfcTerminalTaskParticipant
python_interfaces.rule: participant owns WFM/Task/Objective lifecycle and commits nothing independently; apply runs inside caller's UnitOfWork

python_interfaces.name: RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant
python_interfaces.rule: participant owns Communication links/frozen summary/orphan grace and commits nothing independently; accepted terminal evidence alone never calls apply

python_interfaces.name: RfcInventoryDependencyProvider
python_interfaces.rule: Inventory cannot be deleted or rewritten to manufacture RFC hard-delete eligibility

python_interfaces.name: DeliberateActionProofVerifier
python_interfaces.owner: LLD-12 authenticated-session/action-proof boundary with LLD-10 interaction contract
python_interfaces.rule: proof is server/session-bound evidence for the governed deliberate interaction; a client-supplied boolean/timestamp is never sufficient

python_interfaces.name: SrSourceProjectionService
python_interfaces.owner: LLD-03 Advanced Search acceptance boundary in cooperation with HLD-05
python_interfaces.rule: field precedence, structural allowlist/value-kind checks, pointer ownership guards and compact observation history are defined in schema/sr-source-projection.json and algorithms/sr-source-current.json

python_interfaces.name: DeviceReferenceResolutionReader
python_interfaces.rule: read-only derived registration context; LLD-03 never writes Network Elements or changes relationship target identity

reader_contract: Any repository/service method named reader accepts only a framework-owned read abstraction bound either to a stable Snapshot or the current UnitOfWork. Commands that require authoritative uniqueness/revision/relationship/lifecycle decisions must use the current UnitOfWork reader and must not rely on a pre-lock Snapshot result.
cross_domain_transaction_rule: Import mutation services and terminal-cascade participant apply methods receive the already-open LLD-01 UnitOfWork, may mutate only their owned tables, never commit/rollback independently, and return immutable result references for LLD-01 audit_event_results. Exactly one outer command receipt exists per accepted cross-domain command. Any required participant failure or INDETERMINATE result aborts the transaction.
hard_delete_guard_rule: Preview/commit combine LLD-03 local relationship/note/archive/history checks with RfcSourceEvidenceProvider, RfcTerminalTaskParticipant, RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant and RfcInventoryDependencyProvider. Every provider must be determinate CLEAR; otherwise deletion fails closed.
cross_domain_rules: LLD-03 may reference LLD-02 Customer and Local User Profile IDs but cannot edit that master data through ticket repositories.

LLD-04 owns RFC/WFM workbook staging/evidence and proposal/disposition authority and may submit accepted RFC changes only through RfcImportMutationService; it cannot bypass LLD-03 identity/hierarchy/lifecycle services.
LLD-05 owns WFM/Task lifecycle; Tickets captures/revalidates WFM identity only as cascade evidence and never writes Task lifecycle directly.
LLD-08 owns DeviceReference-to-NetworkElement resolution and Infrastructure entities; Ticket links remain DeviceReference FKs.
LLD-09 owns Communication links/retention; Tickets can coordinate the explicit terminal cascade only through the bounded same-UoW participant interface.
